title: Senior Software Engineer
description: We are looking for a senior software engineer to join our team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining our core products. The ideal candidate has experience with Python, JavaScript, and cloud technologies.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Join our frontend team to build beautiful, responsive web applications. We use modern technologies like React, TypeScript, and GraphQL. Experience with UI/UX design principles is a plus.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Help us build and maintain our cloud infrastructure. You'll work with Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with monitoring and alerting systems is essential.
